source: OSV query for PyPI/pypdf@6.10.0 on 2026-09-28; records point to GitHub and PyPA advisory databases
deduplication_key: GHSA advisory; CVE and PYSEC values are aliases
severity_source: OSV database_specific.severity for the canonical GHSA records
interpretation: The package version is affected, but the 45 identifiers are not 45 independent vulnerabilities. Reachability is assessed against the experimental Stage 3C code only and is not a claim of successful exploitation.

advisories.summary: Long runtime or memory use retrieving outlines
advisories.path: PdfWriter.clone_document_from_reader may copy outline structures; no direct reader.outline access is used.

advisories.summary: Long runtime for zero-only widths in cross-reference streams
advisories.path: PdfReader opens untrusted candidate PDFs before Stage 3C processing.

advisories.summary: Long runtime for invalid size values in incremental mode
advisories.path: PdfReader parses incremental input revisions from the supplied PDF.

advisories.summary: Infinite loop retrieving fonts for layout-mode extraction
advisories.path: Stage 3C calls extract_text() in plain mode, not layout mode.

advisories.summary: Long runtime for repeated malformed cross-reference entries
advisories.path: PdfReader parses cross-reference entries from untrusted candidate inputs.

advisories.summary: Inefficient FlateDecode PNG predictor decoding
advisories.path: Text extraction and cloning can decode content streams; a Stage 3C proof fixture is still required.

advisories.summary: Large memory use for invalid image dimensions
advisories.path: Stage 3C processes image objects, but image decoding is primarily through pikepdf/Pillow; pypdf cloning may still traverse them.

advisories.summary: Infinite loop for unterminated inline images
advisories.path: Content extraction is used, but the experimental parser rejects unsupported inline-image cases; pypdf proof remains required.

advisories.summary: Long runtime or memory use extracting XForm objects
advisories.path: Stage 3C calls page.extract_text(), which traverses form XObjects.

advisories.summary: FlateDecode predictor parameters can exhaust RAM
advisories.path: Untrusted compressed content can be decoded during text extraction; exact trigger path needs a bounded proof fixture.

advisories.summary: Large memory use for large offsets in layout-mode text
advisories.path: Stage 3C does not request layout-mode extraction.

advisories.summary: Inefficient non-whitespace token handling
advisories.path: PdfReader tokenizes attacker-controlled PDF syntax.

advisories.summary: Large memory use for large ToUnicode streams
advisories.path: Stage 3C text extraction consumes font ToUnicode mappings.

advisories.summary: Long runtime or memory use for CID width ranges
advisories.path: Stage 3C text extraction parses CID font widths.

advisories.summary: Infinite loop for unterminated ASCII85/ASCIIHex inline images
advisories.path: Experimental parsing rejects unsupported inline images, but pypdf text extraction still requires a proof fixture.

advisories.summary: Infinite loop processing threads or articles in writer
advisories.path: PdfWriter.clone_document_from_reader is used; whether it processes a malicious article tree needs a bounded proof.

advisories.summary: Large memory use for form XObjects during extraction
advisories.path: Stage 3C calls page.extract_text() on documents that may contain form XObjects.

advisories.summary: Long runtime for invalid sizes in cross-reference and object streams
advisories.path: PdfReader parses cross-reference and object streams before processing.

advisories.summary: Missing stream length values bypass defined limits
advisories.path: PdfReader and extract_text process attacker-controlled streams.

advisories.summary: Infinite loop in TreeObject.insert_child
advisories.path: Writer cloning can rebuild tree structures; no direct insert_child call appears in Stage 3C.

advisories.summary: Infinite loop processing outlines in writer
advisories.path: PdfWriter.clone_document_from_reader may copy malicious outlines.

advisories.summary: XMP metadata streams can exhaust RAM
advisories.path: Stage 3C reads document-info metadata, not XMP directly; cloning may still copy the stream.

advisories.summary: FlateDecode image dimensions can exhaust RAM
advisories.path: Image processing exists, but pypdf is not the primary raster decoder; cloning or extraction may still traverse the object.

required_action: Security must accept a documented experimental exception, remove pypdf from the candidate design, or review a separate dependency-change request. This task does not upgrade the package.
